title: 去饭店吃午饭
topicEn: Going to a restaurant for lunch

explanations.1: 和 connects 我 and 朋友, meaning 'and'.
explanations.2: 从 indicates the starting point of 出发.
explanations.3: 里 indicates location inside the restaurant.
explanations.4: 很 modifies 多, meaning 'very many'.
explanations.5: 多 indicates a large quantity of people.
explanations.6: 了 marks the completion of ordering.
explanations.7: 十 is the number ten before 个.
explanations.8: 个 is a measure word for dumplings.
explanations.9: 八 is the number eight before 个.
explanations.10: 先 indicates the order of actions, meaning 'first'.
explanations.11: 这 points to the water being referred to.
explanations.12: 不 negates the action of drinking.
explanations.13: 的 shows possession between 朋友 and 饺子.
explanations.14: 能 expresses ability to eat many dumplings.
explanations.15: 都 means 'all' of us were happy.
explanations.16: 非常 intensifies 高兴, meaning 'very'.
explanations.17: 太 expresses excessiveness in 好看.
explanations.20: 再 indicates repetition of the action 'come again'.

translation: Today, I and my friend go to a restaurant to eat lunch. We depart from home together. There are many people in the restaurant. We order dumplings. I want ten, he wants eight. We drink water first. This water is very cool. My friend does not drink water; he eats dumplings. My friend's dumplings are very delicious. My friend can eat many dumplings. He eats fifteen, I eat ten. We are all very happy. In the afternoon we go watch a movie. The movie is too good. Will we still come tomorrow? He says not coming. We will come again together next time.
